title: [NSW] $10 Whole Charcoal Chicken, Mondays to Fridays 10am-6pm (Take Away Only) @ Hawa Charcoal Chicken
body:
Deal: [NSW] $10 Whole Charcoal Chicken, Mondays to Fridays 10am-6pm (Take Away Only) @ Hawa Charcoal Chicken

[FlyerOne] Tastes a lot better. Can get a little dry though. It's Leb style chicken. Think El Jannah.
It's a decent promo tbh, you'll go in for the chook and walk out with tabouli, chips, homous and pickles as well.
[Fire Chicken] Chicken is way juicier than EJs these days.
No amount of garlic sauce can save dry chicken.
[jamesligit] The poster was in the Granville store, might apply to others.
[Black Feed Dog] they are great, can eat them all day everyday. wonder why there isn't a convention to use capital city abbreviations like syd instead of nsw, a lot of deals/stores are capital cities only
[garage sale] Sadly not in Melbourne, this would be wayyy better than Cole’s or Woolies roast chicken.
[spy] Anything better than them nowadays unfortunately
[dajiska] can someone confirm if this applies to other stores?
[amygirl] I think it’s the Granville store only according to their TikTok page.
[humdingaling] Its this week only
seems to be Granville only
[humdingaling] also mentioned on FB they extend to 11pm
After receiving amazing feedback from our loyal customers, so many of you asked us to extend the $9.99 Whole Charcoal Chicken Deal and make it available for longer.

[whyisave] Thanks for this deal.
It's been a few years since i had some Hawa Chicken.
